policy: Metadata only. Binaries are fetched by the owner from the original author's page (scripts/fetch_dev_pack.py verifies size and SHA-512) into an untracked directory and are never committed, uploaded as artifacts or redistributed. Every entry is an exact pin chosen after reading the release metadata and, where noted in docs/technical/mod-audit.md, the jar contents. A pin is not a certification of combined gameplay.

mods.notes: MIT. Pinned at 1.20-7.5.5 (the version the road and city surveys were measured on); newer 7.5.6 and 7.5.7 exist and are NOT adopted without a re-run of the world survey.

mods.role: firearms, ammunition, attachments and gun smith tables
mods.notes: GPL-3.0-only code; default gun pack assets are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (private use only, no redistribution of modified assets). The jar was opened: 54 guns, 24 ammo types and 95 attachments in the default pack, items tacz:modern_kinetic_gun / tacz:ammo / tacz:attachment, gun smith table recipes of type tacz:gun_smith_table_crafting.

mods.role: research addon: every gun is gated behind a blueprint item learned per player
mods.notes: All rights reserved (source published). Per-gun blueprint items, a per-player unlock capability, /blueprints commands and a chest loot injector configurable by table. Early release 0.1.3: no research bench yet. Selected over the CurseForge-only 'TaCZ Weapon Research & Blueprints' because that file could not be located and verified from the cloud container.

mods.role: motorboat with a 27-slot persistent hold and fuel
mods.notes: All rights reserved. MotorboatEntity implements Container (27 slots) and saves its items through ContainerHelper (read from the jar bytecode). It reads its config in the mod constructor, which Forge throws on in the *development* environment only, so it cannot boot under ForgeGradle; it is exercised by the production-style boot check (scripts/run_prod_boot_check.py), not by -PucPack. Crafting is enabled by default (enableMotorboat).

mods.role: car, truck and bike engine (content packs required)
mods.notes: All rights reserved. Ships no vehicles by itself.

mods.role: official content: pickup/flatbed trucks, a jeep, a quad bike, crates and barrels as cargo parts
mods.notes: All rights reserved. Eighteen vehicles (cars, trucks, aircraft); no boats.
All rights reserved. Mod ID is checked against the jar when the pack is first booted.

mods.role: shared library the Let's Do mods require
mods.notes: LGPL-3.0-only. Pinned at 9.2.14 (Forge 1.20.1); Vinery needs >= 9.0.8. A library, never an authority.

mods.role: candidate legal wine provider (vineyard, grape press, fermenting barrel)
mods.notes: [Let's Do] Vinery 1.4.41. Licence is the authors' custom text (not retrievable from the cloud container); treated as: private play only, never redistributed, binary fetched from the author's page. Candidate for the Vintner's legal branch (D-067, proposed): not adopted until a real-client inspection and a dedicated-server boot are recorded.

mods.role: candidate crop and farmhouse-cooking provider for the Farmer
mods.notes: [Let's Do] Farm & Charm 1.0.14. Custom licence (see vinery). Candidate for the Farmer's legal crops (D-067, proposed): not adopted until inspected.

mods.role: candidate spirits and cocktail provider (barrel brewing: vodka, whiskey, rum, brandy) for the Vintner's underground path
mods.notes: Kaleidoscope Tavern 1.2.0, BSD-3-Clause code and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 assets (private, non-commercial play; never redistributed). Barrel recipes turn water and potato, wheat or sugar cane into unaged spirits in two minutes (a crude home brew, not a still). Chosen over Tadacko's Drinks, whose pot and column stills are the better fit but whose 1.0.0 to 1.2.0 jars crash a dedicated server at mod construction (a client-only class loaded by an automatic event subscriber). Not adopted until a dedicated-server boot and a real-client inspection of this exact jar are recorded.

mods.role: recipe and usage viewer (candidate quality-of-life interface)
mods.notes: Just Enough Items 15.56.0.205, the latest non-beta 1.20.1 Forge release (newer builds are betas that need MezzConfig). MIT. Client and server optional. Opt-in set 'qol': it lets a player look up the Vintner's and Farmer's recipes in game; Core does not depend on it.

mods.role: look-at tooltips (crop growth, machine state) (candidate quality-of-life interface)
mods.notes: Jade 11.13.3. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Client and server optional. Opt-in set 'qol': shows what a block or plant is and how grown it is; Core does not depend on it.

mods.role: library of the Sophisticated mods: the storage engine, the upgrade system and their configuration (required by Sophisticated Backpacks)
mods.notes: Sophisticated Core 1.20.1-1.5.12.2412 (2026-10-17, release). All Rights Reserved; private use of the author's own download only. Declared dependencies: Forge 47.1+, JEI optional (client). Contains an optional Create compatibility mixin plugin (CreateMixinConfigPlugin) that applies only when Create is installed; Create is NOT a dependency and is never installed here (D-080). Core's enabledItems config disables an item and its recipe by registry name.

mods.role: backpacks: a wearable or placeable pack with upgrade slots and tiered capacity (the survival set's one backpack provider, D-092)
mods.notes: Sophisticated Backpacks 1.20.1-3.26.12.2206 (2026-10-13, release). All Rights Reserved; private use of the author's own download only, never committed or redistributed. Requires Sophisticated Core [1.5.8.+,) and Forge 47.1+; JEI, Curios, Chipped, Crafting Tweaks, Trash Slot and Item Borders are optional and not installed. Replaces Traveler's Backpack (owner direction, October 19, 2026). Server config tunes capacity, upgrades and nerfs (see docs/technical/backpack-economy.md).

mods.role: LEGACY (superseded by Sophisticated Backpacks, D-092): the old survival set's backpack, kept pinned only so that a world that already holds Traveler's Backpack items can be opened once, emptied and migrated (see docs/technical/backpack-migration.md). Never combined with Sophisticated Backpacks.
mods.notes: Traveler's Backpack 1.20.1-9.1.57 (2026-08-29, release). LGPL-3.0-only. It was the survival set's backpack in the October 18 sprint (D-085) and is replaced by Sophisticated Backpacks by the owner's direction of October 19, 2026 (D-092). Opt-in set 'legacy_travelers' exists only for old-world migration; it is not part of 'survival' and must not be loaded together with Sophisticated Backpacks. One start in eight of a fresh server crashed in TravelersBackpackConfig$Server.loadItemsFromConfig (config reload race).

mods.role: thirst, drinking, water purity, canteens and flasks (the survival set's one thirst provider)
mods.notes: Thirst Was Taken 2 1.9.0 (2026-10-15, release). GPL-3.0-only. Optional integrations only (AppleSkin, Jade, Farmer's Delight, and a Create hook that is NOT used: Create is excluded, D-080). Items include a waterskin, a copper canteen, iron, diamond and netherite flasks, a sand filter and a copper distiller. Chosen over the older Thirst Was Taken 1.4.0 (MIT, stale since mid-2025, five items; its canteen add-on is all rights reserved) and Tough As Nails (beta, all rights reserved, needs Glitchcore, bundles a harsh temperature model).

mods.role: food variety, cooking pot, cutting board (the survival set's one kitchen)
mods.notes: Farmer's Delight 1.3.4 (2026-08-29, release). MIT; no mandatory dependency. Chosen as the kitchen so that the pack has one: it overlaps [Let's Do] Farm & Charm (stove, cooking pot, roaster), so the 'farming' set is not combined with it by default. Core's recipes and orders are unaffected.

mods.role: sleeping bags and hammocks that do not set a respawn point
mods.notes: Comforts 6.4.0+1.20.1 (2024-07-05, release). LGPL-3.0-or-later; no mandatory dependency. Matches D-079: resting is never an automatic change of respawn.

external.name: Q Shop
external.role: the single wallet and civilian shop provider (D-037, D-039)
external.notes: Resolved by Gradle from the author's GitHub release with checksum verification; not available on Modrinth.
